title: Red Deer Museum and Art Gallery

services.name: Room Rentals
services.desc: Located in the heart of downtown Red Deer, with ample free parking and great break out space, there’s no better place to hold your next event! Comfortable capacity for each space will depend on configuration. All Room rental rates are subject to GST. $100 per hour minimum of 2 hour booking required, maximum booking 8 hours per day Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, & Saturday - 10AM-4:30PM Wednesday & Friday - 10AM-8PM Closed on Sundays & Holidays* *Except Remembrance Day, Family Day, & Heritage

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: These one-day day camps will provide your child with a fun way to spend the day during a teacher in-service day (PD day). Every camp will consist of a theme based art craft, several indoor and outdoor activities, and time in the galleries to explore. Drop off from 8:45 a.m. - 9 a.m. Camp runs 9 a.m.-4 p.m. Pick up from 4 p.m. - 4:15 p.m. Before care is available from 8:15 a.m. to 8:45 a.m. After care is available from 4:15 p.m. to 5 p.m. Registration for a before or after care session is required and the cost for each session is $5.00 per child. Registering for before and after care costs $10.00 per child, per day. Important Note: MAG Day Camps are peanut/nut free. Please ensure the snacks

services.name: Talks & Tours
services.desc: are a great way to gain in-depth knowledge and understanding of Red Deer or the temporary exhibitions programmed at the MAG. Talks & Tours can offer insight into the artist, historian, or storyteller - their process, expertise, or topic. Increase your visual literacy by looking at art and engaging with the artist. Expand your knowledge of social history and culture with local or regional history experts and storytellers. All Walking Tours require registration. Most onsite Talks & Tours are drop-in and free to attend unless noted otherwise - we always appreciate receiving cash donations. Join the exhibiting artist or exhibition curator as they discuss their artistic practice
